expression.neutral: relaxed face, no particular emotion, mouth closed
expression.smile: gentle smile, slight upward curve of lips, soft eyes
expression.laugh: wide open mouth laughing, eyes squinting with joy, raised cheeks
expression.tired: half-closed droopy eyes, slight frown, slouched posture
expression.worried: furrowed brows, slightly biting lower lip, tense shoulders
expression.surprised: wide open eyes, raised eyebrows, mouth slightly open in O shape
expression.determined: firm gaze forward, clenched jaw, confident upright posture
expression.relieved: exhaling with closed eyes, relaxed shoulders, soft gentle smile

pose.stand: standing upright with both feet on the ground, arms at sides
pose.sit: sitting on a chair, back straight, hands on lap or desk
pose.slump: shoulders drooped forward, head tilted down, curved back
pose.point: one arm extended forward, index finger pointing at something
pose.arms_up: both arms raised above head in celebration or stretching
pose.walk: mid-stride walking pose, one foot forward, arms swinging naturally
pose.stretch: arms reaching upward or outward, body elongated, slight back arch
pose.lie_down: lying flat on back or side, body horizontal, relaxed limbs

shot_type.closeup: framing from shoulders up, face fills most of the frame
shot_type.bust: framing from chest up, showing upper body and face
shot_type.waist: framing from waist up, showing torso and arms
shot_type.full: full body visible from head to toe, some space around the figure
shot_type.wide: character small in frame, environment dominates the composition

camera_angle.eye: camera at eye level, straight-on perspective, neutral angle
camera_angle.high: camera looking down from above, character appears smaller
camera_angle.low: camera looking up from below, character appears taller and imposing

time_of_day.morning: warm golden sunrise light, soft long shadows from the left
time_of_day.noon: bright overhead sunlight, short shadows, vivid clear colors
time_of_day.evening: warm orange-pink sunset glow, long shadows, golden hour tones
time_of_day.night: dark blue sky, artificial indoor or street lighting, cool tones
